evals.prompt: Rewrite the description of positron-ai/tron PR #4868 into the PR-description sections (Short version, Background, Words used here, How to review this PR). Fetch the live body and the diff with gh. Keep everything after those four sections as it is. Write the result to a file; do not post it.
evals.expected_output: A markdown file with the four sections in order, the Short version in three sentences, a glossary of project terms only, and a Q-and-A review section with at most three items per list, under about 1,000 words for the four sections.

evals.prompt: I just pushed branch jhan-vnnik-2-amx (PR #4887). Write me a PR body for it. The AMX kernel reads the VNNI K plane as its B operand; the identity test compares it with the row-major kernel bit for bit.
evals.expected_output: A body with the four sections, written from the diff and tests, with the review section naming where the kernel could be wrong (operand orientation, tile bounds, the gate) and the choices a reviewer might make differently.

evals.prompt: Here is a diff that adds a --pay-for-determinism flag to rinzler (fixed-order sums). Write the PR description. The flag is off by default.
evals.expected_output: A short body: three-sentence Short version naming the default, a short Background, a small glossary, and a review section with one or two verified questions rather than a file list.
